_DescriptionConcurrencyValue.comment: The 'Based on number of CPU cores' refers to the string OptionConcurrencyValueMachineSize in this file. The 'Adjust dynamically' refers to the string OptionConcurrencyValueAuto in this file. Please make sure their translation matches.
_DescriptionPreserveBlobTags.comment: The 'Detect', 'Preserve', 'Don't Preserve' in the string refers to the string AzCopySettings.EnumDetect, AzCopySettings.EnumPreserve, AzCopySettings.EnumNotPreserve in this file. Please make sure the strings match.
DescriptionAllowMultiProcess: If enabled, Storage Explorer may run multiple AzCopy processes concurrently. This is not guaranteed to improve performance, and may result in higher consumption of system resources. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionAutoDeleteLogs: If enabled, Storage Explorer will automatically delete AzCopy logs of transfers with no failed or skipped items.
DescriptionAzCopy: Use these settings to tune the performance of AzCopy. AzCopy is used for Blobs, File Share, ADLS Gen2 and Managed Disks.
DescriptionAzCopyCommandShellLanguage: The shell language to use when constructing AzCopy commands. If set to 'Auto', the shell language will be determined based on the current system.
DescriptionBandwidthLimit: Caps the transfer rate in Mbps. Consider changing this value if AzCopy congests your bandwidth. If left blank, the transfer rate won't be capped.
DescriptionBlobEnable: If enabled, AzCopy will be used for uploading and downloading blobs. AzCopy provides a more performant experience than the old upload and download method.
DescriptionBlobSasDuration: The duration in days of SAS tokens generated for AzCopy transfers. If the SAS token is a user delegation SAS, the duration is capped at 7 days. If your transfers fail to complete before their tokens expire, increase this value to give them more time to finish.
DescriptionBufferSize: Max number of GB that AzCopy should use for buffering data between network and disk. May include decimal point, e.g. 0.5. Consider changing this value if AzCopy uses too much memory. If left blank, the number will be based on machine size.
DescriptionCheckMd5: Specifies how strictly MD5 hashes should be validated when downloading. This setting does not apply when downloading Disks. For Disk download, the MD5 hash is not validated.
DescriptionConcurrencyFiles: Overrides the (approximate) number of files that are in progress at any time, by controlling how many files AzCopy concurrently initiates transfers for. Consider changing this value if AzCopy frequently reaches the maximum open file limit of your local system. Valid input values are positive whole numbers.
DescriptionConcurrencyValue:
Overrides the number of HTTP connections working on transfers. Valid input values are positive whole numbers.

For File Share transfers, selecting 'Based on number of CPU cores' is equivalent to selecting 'Adjust dynamically' in order to avoid being throttled by the service.
DescriptionDecompress: If enabled, AzCopy will decompress downloaded files if their Content-Encoding indicates that they are compressed. Supported Content-Encoding values are 'gzip' and 'deflate'. File extensions of '.gz'/'.gzip' or '.zz' aren't necessary, but will be removed if present.
DescriptionDisableAutoDecoding: If enabled, AzCopy will not decode encoded illegal Windows characters in file names when uploading to destinations which support illegal Windows characters.
DescriptionForceIfReadOnly: If enabled, AzCopy will force delete files with the read-only SMB property set.
DescriptionIncludeDirectoryStub: If enabled, AzCopy will preserve directory stubs during service to service transfers. Directory stubs are blobs with metadata 'hdi_isfolder=true'.
DescriptionLogLevel: The log verbosity level for AzCopy. Options are ordered from least to most verbose.
DescriptionPreserveAccessTier: If enabled, AzCopy will preserve access tier when copying blobs. If the destination doesn't support access tier, AzCopy will complete the transfer without preserving the access tier.
DescriptionPreserveBlobTags: Determines whether AzCopy will preserve blob tags when copying blobs. If set to 'Detect', AzCopy will only preserve tags if the source and the destination support tags, and if they have the permissions required to preserve tags. If set to 'Preserve', AzCopy will always attempt to preserve blob tags. If set to 'Don't preserve', AzCopy won't preserve blob tags.
DescriptionPreserveInfo: If enabled, AzCopy will preserve file properties (e.g. last modified time, creation time, attribute bits) between supported resources, such as between Windows and SMB file shares or between Linux and NFS file shares. Only the attribute bits supported by Azure Files will be transferred; any others will be ignored. The information transferred for folders is the same as that for files, except for last modified time, which is never preserved for folders.
DescriptionPreservePermissions: If enabled, AzCopy will preserve permissions between supported resources, such as access control lists between Windows and SMB files shares or owners and groups between Linux and NFS file shares.
DescriptionPreserveSymlinks: If enabled, AzCopy will preserve symbolic links when copying to or from NFS file shares.
DescriptionPutMd5: If enabled, AzCopy will compute and save an MD5 hash for uploaded files. This setting does not apply when uploading Disks. For Disk upload, the MD5 hash is neither computed nor saved.
DescriptionTransferBlockBlobsWithMinimal: If enabled, block blobs will be transferred with the minimum number of blocks. This setting may be useful if you have permissions to create but not write blobs. Enabling this setting may have adverse effects on the time it takes to complete transfers. The number of blocks will automatically be minimized if Storage Explorer detects that you only have create permissions.
MenuBlobEnable: Use AzCopy for Improved Blob Upload and Download
OptionConcurrencyValueMachineSize: Based on number of CPU cores
